full_name: Maya Vinokour | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2026–2027 Humanities Frieda L. Miller Fellow New York University
bio: Maya Vinokour is a literary scholar who studies the cultures of Stalinism and Nazism and their relationship to today’s global far right; memory and trauma in the Soviet Union after Stalin; and 20th and 21st century media.
